title: Advancing a new approach to cardiovascular immunotherapy.
intro: ATH101 is a preclinical research program. Later stages below are shown for orientation only and have not been reached.

earlyResearch.title: Early Research
earlyResearch.body: The supplied presentation describes reduced plaque coverage in treated groups versus a diseased control in an experimental mouse model. These results are preclinical. Safety and effectiveness in humans have not been established.
